item.title: THC Setup, Tuning, and Stopping Torch Dives

item.title: Air Supply, Air Quality, and X45 Consumables

item.title: Razorcut 45 (X45 Torch) Cut Settings

item.title: Getting Rid of Dross and Bevel

item.title: Kerf Width and Hole/Part Accuracy
item.description: Measuring kerf and cutting accurate holes and parts on a CrossFire PRO with the Razorcut 45 and X45 torch, using SheetCAM v8 kerf offsets: a 2 in square test, a hole coupon, and forum kerf numbers.

item.title: Test-Cut Program: Checking the Starting Settings, Coupon by Coupon
item.description: A planned, coupon-by-coupon test program for checking the Razorweld-supplied chart (and the T45m-format chart’s voltages) on a CrossFire PRO with the Razorcut 45 and X45 torch, with every cut logged.

item.title: CrossFire PRO Plasma Procedures
item.description:
Last updated: 30 October 2026

Personal notes, unlisted. I’m Bernie Lindsey, a new CrossFire PRO owner. These are my notes, put together with help from an AI research assistant that read Langmuir and Razorweld documents and Langmuir forum posts. Where a page says “I” or “my”, it means me and my machine. Most of this is compiled research I haven’t tried yet; each page has a status line saying which. Not affiliated with Langmuir Systems, Razorweld, or Jasic. Follow the manufacturers’ manuals, safety instructions, and support advice over anything here. More in About this site, including a glossary.

item.title: Cut Chart Images
item.description: The Razorweld-supplied Razorcut 45 chart and the three T45m-format charts as images. The typed-in tables and how to use them are on the cut settings page.
